scope: Review of the unchanged code inputs used by the new 95-96D certificate. This is not a complete kissing-number literature survey.

primary_sources.input: Explicit nested concatenation recipe for a binary [96,33,24] code; Y. Cheng, IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory 33 (1987), 719-721.
primary_sources.observation: Lower bound on minimum distance remains 24; replay rebuilds the generator and verifies the parent codes.
Only the explicit 16384-word code is used; its distance is freshly enumerated.
